name: Ikeno
source:
An eccentric employee of Paradise. He plays a variety of roles to suit the patients' fantasies. For example, to Alice, he is sometimes the Cheshire Cat, the Hatter, the Dormouse, or the March Hare.

[translated from [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/fairy/index.html]official website[/url]]
